sections.heading: Planned operation and consumer boundaries
sections.excerpt:
The seven public operations are plan, attach, evaluate, seal, verify, inspect
and render. They require complete installed entry points, original records,
source-role/currentness qualification and actual consumer tests. Existing plan,
attach, evaluate, seal, inspect and render controllers are exported by the library
and loaded when selected. The measurement namespace does not import their suppliers.
The custody attach branch checks whole HAL/QPU source identities, preserves
every raw row and retains explicit target/panel/count bindings. It emits honest
native unavailability until the actual original qualification population exists.
Full native attach, evaluate and verify implementations and the seven CLI commands
remain unfinished.

Qualified original job evidence and the common evidence package must supply
their own supported source, ledger, canonicalisation and verification contracts.
Their absence is a dependency gap. MITIGATION-WITNESS does not supply a private
replacement signer, registry, root, serializer or trust-on-first-use verifier.
Studio integration must present original scope, methods, origins, results and
refusals using the actual owning consumer. That integration is still incomplete.

See [the threat model](THREAT_MODEL.md) and
[the repository-boundary decision](adr/0001-repository-boundary.md).

sections.heading: Controlled source evaluation
sections.excerpt:
The evaluation controller reconstructs the original plan/attachment source
candidates from their retained inputs, rechecks all QPU archive rows and binds
held-out cases in frozen order. It checks complete count inventories and panel
QPY byte references through EMT before entering any native adapter. Repeated
input records and method calibration/scale inventories share whole capture,
reference and occurrence limits.

Every actual source outcome and progress transition is retained, including
zero retention, native arithmetic refusal, cancellation and an expired local
monotonic deadline. Without worker limits, controls cooperate between cases.
Explicit worker limits select an owned spawned process that can be interrupted
while its fixed native method is active. Complete original documents, source inputs and run results
are published as one exclusive bundle. EvaluationUnavailable carries that full
attempt because complete native estimate/evaluation/certificate construction
and domain admission remain unfinished. A schema-less source run record supplies
neither a native process audit nor scientific support.

sections.heading: Known-answer and estimate source construction
sections.excerpt:
EvaluationContext.source_inputs selects the complete ordered EvaluationSourceInput
with one CaseEstimateSource per fixed held-out case. Preparation validates every
nongenerated field and identity, binds the original observable and subject bytes,
constructs whole known-answer source candidates and captures actual interpreter,
platform, distribution metadata and loaded module origins before adapter work.
Those local observations do not qualify the complete environment/software profile.
The supplied ideal observation is retained as declared_unverified.

Estimate construction generates all twenty-eight fields from every actual case
and the full caller declarations. Runtime points and retained parity counts keep
actual source references. Empirical error composition has its own stored values
and original operands before the estimate references them. Precancellation or an
expired deadline retains not_run and unavailable native outputs; a failed adapter
with no observed native result retains an unavailable estimate position. Original
variance, uncertainty, bias, completeness and qualification declarations survive;
source shape does not admit those declarations.

The full EvaluationAttempt.source_construction remains independently unadmitted.
Late source-shape or reference-budget refusal retains all actual run cases and
all original input files without publishing a successful estimate prefix. Native
evaluation/certificate, full fixed criterion replay and separate domain/current,
process/clock/source/math/statistical qualification remain unfinished.

sections.heading: Whole criterion and evaluation source replay
sections.excerpt:
EvaluationSourceInput.evaluation selects the complete eight-field
EvaluationRecordInput and one MetricEvidence or explicit missing slot per fixed
criterion. Preparation checks original identity/order, metric and complete case
scope, retains every source byte and shares whole capture/record/reference
limits. The original comparison module evaluates every fixed criterion with its
hypothesis, unreduced boundary and equality, preserving unavailable, outside and
overlap relations. Mathematical boxes and error assumptions supply no confidence
or numerical/source admission.

EvaluationRecordSource retains the full original request, every diagnostic and
comparison record. A complete nineteen-field evaluation source candidate derives
original plan/attachment/window/prior/purpose, ordered criterion results and full
estimate references from owning records. Available comparisons produce descriptive
source outcomes, while missing/refused evidence produces unavailable outcomes.
Original caller proof/completeness/limitation declarations remain unadmitted.
No supported, violated or statistical inconclusive outcome follows from source
arithmetic. A complete-panel criterion without its actual complete estimate
binding retains every case and keeps the whole candidate unavailable.

Atomic source outcome handling preserves all input/run bytes when late candidate
schema/reference construction refuses. EvaluationUnavailable still carries the
full attempt, source constructions and exclusive output bundle. Native certificate,
full qualified aggregation, source/math/statistical/current/process/clock admission,
independent verification and whole CLI/Studio acceptance remain unfinished.

sections.heading: Complete certificate source construction
sections.excerpt:
EvaluationSourceInput.certificate accepts CertificateSourceInput containing
exactly four nongenerated fields: identity, claims, completeness and limitations.
The calibration_inventory is a complete RawJsonObject or an explicit absence.
Preparation preserves all original bytes and validates the full identity and UTC
calendar without granting trusted time. Shared capture, record, input-byte and
reference limits cover the complete request and outputs.

The constructor derives all twenty-one certificate fields from its own complete
plan, attachment, known answers, criteria, estimates and evaluation. It checks
planned calibration against the fixed original reference, or observed calibration
against both its fixed prior and the evaluation observation reference. Technique
binding must agree. Missing calibration, evaluation or any estimate prevents the
entire candidate. Original claims and qualification declarations survive unchanged.
The fixed target ownership and panel/window claim boundary are retained.

EvaluationAttempt.certificate_source contains the complete source candidate or
explicit missing-input reasons. Late schema/reference/resource refusal preserves
the full run and inputs in the exclusive atomic bundle. Its admission remains
not_evaluated; this source result does not return an admitted MitigationDraft.
Actual observed calibration production and qualification, full aggregation,
native evaluation/certificate admission and independent verification remain
unfinished.

sections.heading: Observed readout calibration sources
sections.excerpt:
EvaluationSourceInput.readout_calibration supplies an explicit new inventory ID,
the full earlier planned inventory, and every original provenance/count object in
method-input order. Raw count objects retain the complete CountInventory source
representation. Each provenance raw_counts_ref and captured_shots must agree with
the actual count bytes and native method input. The fixed calibration reference,
technique and exact rational cutoff bind the earlier prescription. Equivalent
unreduced cutoff fields stay unchanged; no refitting or new source origin follows.

Every actual native case fit must exist and agree on calibration counts, labels,
matrix, shots, condition number and cutoff. The complete observed inventory keeps
all thirteen original fields, with stage observed, a reference to the earlier
planned bytes and actual fit execution/input/output/environment references.
Full original matrix quantities, counts and native cutoff/condition values remain
in the captured matrix record. Provenance columns follow native basis order,
while every original method/source/count byte remains unchanged in publication.
Qualification, covariance, clipping bias and completeness declarations are retained.

The owner generates the evaluation observation link from the actual constructed
inventory. An existing available caller link must agree with those exact bytes.
Certificate construction checks the original planned input and binds the actual
observed inventory through its prior and evaluation links. If any requested native
fit is missing or source/schema/reference construction refuses, the whole downstream
candidate remains unavailable and every original case, input and run survives.
ReadoutCalibrationSourceConstruction has admission not_evaluated; matrix capture
does not admit statist

sections.heading: Predeclared parity and ZNE calibration sources
sections.excerpt:
EvaluationSourceInput.case_calibration supplies CaseCalibrationSourceInput with
inventory_id, the complete earlier planned inventory, immutable fit_case_ids and
every provenance/raw-count source. Only one readout or case calibration request is
allowed. Every fit ID must match the original prescribed scope and source-case
inventory before execution. Parity pins exactly one case because its original
inventory has one raw_count_source slot. ZNE preserves all selected cases in their
original order and every prescribed odd scale and polynomial order. Full count
representation, raw reference bytes and independent totals bind the method inputs.

All actual original case results are retained. Missing native work keeps the whole
requested observed inventory unavailable. A complete fit capture retains the
predeclared parity case or every ZNE case/scale, actual native diagnostics, input
rounding residuals and all original count declarations. The thirteen-field observed
inventory retains original qualification, completeness, partition/window and
sector/conservation or scaling/covariance/bias declarations. Actual execution and
captured count-source declarations do not establish source roles or independence;
reused fit/evaluation data remain reuse. No case is selected after its result.

Both observed producer types feed owning evaluation and certificate references.
EvaluationAttempt.case_calibration_source exposes their entire candidate or absence.
Receipts distinguish readout and case calibration requests from unrequested sources,
and each construction status from native/scientific admission. Native-qualified
Draft construction and full independent domain/current verification remain separate.

sections.heading: Original schema component predicates
sections.excerpt:
SchemaCatalogue.validate_component accepts an exact catalogue definition ID, a
nonempty RFC6901 pointer, complete RawJsonObject data and explicit pointer text
bound. Pointer syntax, canonical array indices, membership and schema target type
are checked before evaluating the original predicates. URI escaping preserves
literal percent, tilde, slash and Unicode keys. Unknown pointers and scalar data
targets refuse; original boolean schemas retain their native predicate behavior.
The existing immutable offline registry resolves local and external schema refs.
No retrieval callback, URI alias, replacement definition or new native ID is used.

SchemaComponentObservation retains the complete defining source pin, original
pointer and unchanged data. Refusal retains the existing public
SchemaValidationRefusal type and full original input/schema. Root schema validation
keeps its prior behavior; source types and native predicate execution are separated
from catalogue membership/dependency construction.

All calibration producers validate every full count_source declaration through the
original calibration_inventory.v2 /$defs/count_source component after actual SDK
execution. This also covers ZNE declarations stored in separately referenced scale
records. Missing or malformed source fields keep the whole observed inventory and
downstream candidate unavailable, preserving all original cases, inputs and native
results. Shape agreement continues to grant no origin, role, clock, independence,
source qualification or scientific support.

sections.heading: Original verification policy and byte-bound scope
sections.excerpt:
bind_mitigation_policy validates the complete original policy.v1 against its exact
pinned definition and retains all source bytes. MitigationPolicy exposes a detached
full object and original ordered required_gate_ids. The native predicates require
all 21 gate names and every policy/profile/resource field; no missing requirement,
clock, reference or accepted gate is supplied by the decoder.

observe_policy_scope takes the whole policy, certificate, plan, technique, ordered
criteria and known-answer population with explicit shared capture/reference costs
and a whole occurrence bound. Every original native source is schema checked.
Complete criterion order and panel scope must agree across certificate/plan; all
plan, technique, criterion and known-answer links are checked against actual bytes
using the sole EMT helper with original descriptor basis/metadata preserved.
Every missing required technique/panel/criterion/accuracy metric and every answer
outside the accepted roles stays in original policy/source order. Supplied extras
remain in the complete original population, never a selected passing subset.

PolicyScopeObservation retains every full input and real cumulative helper cost,
with admission not_evaluated. Scope membership, reference agreement and policy
shape do not verify intent, currentness, clock/trust, shot sufficiency or the 21
domain gates. Full independent verify and native/current result construction
remain unfinished.

sections.heading: Common verification boundary
sections.excerpt:
`CommonVerificationInput` retains the selected transport references, full native
certificate, full common manifest and ordered envelope bytes. The binding phase
uses actual EMT references, checks the exact payload reference and complete claim
echo, and preserves duplicate occurrences. Whole input-byte and envelope bounds
include explicit control envelopes; the actual helper costs remain visible.
The complete native certificate, manifest and native policy also share a whole
JSON value-capture bound; individually valid documents cannot reset that budget.
EMT applies its separate complete graph/control acquisition limits.

`verify_common` requires the independently selected common policy and trust
context. Neither input is selected from the artifact or an ambient clock. The
native policy must bind the exact common policy descriptor. Missing authority,
source mismatch and actual common failures retain the entire original selection
in `CommonVerificationRefusal`, with an exact input/configuration pointer and the
actual authored cause. The controller writes no files and changes no trust state.

A returned `CommonMitigationVerification` holds the unchanged actual EMT report
and all original inputs. It does not serialize a native common-report payload or
execute MITIGATION-WITNESS's independent twenty-one domain/current gates.

sections.heading: Complete native subject preflight
sections.excerpt:
`NativeVerificationInput` retains the whole plan, attachment, technique, planned
and selected calibration, window and evaluation sources. Ordered panel, answer,
criterion, statistical-profile and estimate tuples preserve duplicates and
explicit missing slots. The planned calibration cannot be replaced by an
observed inventory.

When `native_inputs` and `native_limits` are supplied together in
`CommonVerificationContext`, the public `verify_common` operation schema-checks
every available original, shares its existing capture and EMT helper budget, and
binds fixed native edges before evaluating common authority. It checks full panel
and criterion inventory, prior held-out case order, fit/held-out overlap,
calibration fit inventory and stage, evaluation purpose, and complete criterion
result order/case/metric fields. These checks establish source consistency only.

Nested references are joined against the complete selected certificate cohorts.
Every matching repeated occurrence is checked; unavailable targets and unmatched
extra source slots remain visible. Ordinary reference mismatches are collected
through the entire graph. Resource exhaustion stops replay and preserves all
original input custody. `NativeSubjectRefusal.binding` retains the completed
whole graph when available; early shape/resource failures retain the whole input
and original cause. No partial graph is labelled successful.

This preflight does not execute the twenty-one domain/current gates, admit a
physical window, qualify an answer or uncertainty model, or construct a native
verification report. Common report production with accepted trust sources and
full native verification remain separate acceptance requirements.

sections.heading: Native policy source replay
sections.excerpt:
The native source phase applies the selected policy's `max_input_bytes`,
`max_panels` and `max_reference_depth` ceilings. Input accounting includes the
complete certificate, every native source occurrence, manifest, original policy,
ordered external envelopes and explicit control envelopes. Repeated bytes count

resource field remains visible in `PolicyResourceReplay.unchecked_fields`.

Each frozen held-out case and each original criterion case retains both sets of
shot minima. One uniquely associated original attachment count source and
estimate supply the declared captured and engine-captured retained strings.
Missing values and multiple matching sources remain unavailable; no acquisition
pooling, favorable source choice or invented zero resolves them. Exact source
comparisons retain all original requirements and existing reasons. A stricter
criterion cannot be replaced by a lower policy minimum.

Every required technique, panel, criterion and accuracy metric ID is compared
with the entire selected source cohort. Answer-role declarations remain separate
from role qualification. A `same_window_panel_support` intent rejects
`simulated_control` purposes and simulated source declarations; missing/unknown
window data remains unavailable. A matching `retained_device` label supplies no
actual physical association or trusted source.

`NativePolicyReplay` keeps the full original policy and source population,
static resource checks, every case/criterion comparison and every scope/intent
comparison. Definite violations refuse with the complete native graph attached.
Early resource refusals retain all original inputs and al

sections.heading: Isolated native source execution
sections.excerpt:
execute_source_study(..., worker_limits=WorkerLimits(...)) selects an isolated
process for every prescribed case. EvaluationContext.worker_limits forwards the
same explicit selection through public evaluate. The six required values are
per-case wall nanoseconds, address-space bytes, CPU seconds, result bytes,
cancellation polling nanoseconds and cleanup nanoseconds. No source artifact selects a program or handler.

Wall time includes spawn, imports, execution, transport and cleanup. Linux
address-space and CPU limits are installed in the fixed worker after trusted
Python bootstrap. The observed entry address space must already fit the selected
memory limit; bootstrap allocation itself requires an outer process ceiling.
Caller cancellation and the whole-study deadline are polled throughout worker
execution and nonblocking result transport. Only this owned child is terminated. All cleanup waits have the explicit
cleanup budget, including the final wait after SIGKILL. The receipt records
no_child, reaped or pending. Pending cleanup stops later native launches while
retaining every case and refusal in the original inventory.

Complete native fields travel through bounded JSON with a closed owned type
inventory. This transport creates no evidence identity or native verification
report. Original parent case objects remain unchanged. The receipt retains
explicit ceilings, actual PID/exit, monotonic coordinates and the observed stop.
An unexplained process exit remains a worker error. A CPU stop after a complete
result retains that actual result beside the refusal. No killed process supplies
a guessed partial observation. These source lifecycle records do not qualify a
process audit, UTC clock, source role or scientific result.

readme_excerpts: Versioned public boundary contracts for the SCPN quantum computing ecosystem.

This local repository is being constructed at architecture-only maturity. It has no implemented domain contracts, distributable package, scientific capabilities or qualified claims. It will hold the provider-neutral result/parameter records, semantic qualification records and evidence envelopes shared by the numerical libraries, hardware abstraction layer and independent evidence tools.

The existing SCPN-QUANTUM-CONTROL workbench remains the source and integration home. This repository does not move its code or replace the portfolio's existing evidence semantics. Contracts are aligned with their actual upstream ownership; an incompatible duplicate schema is a defect.

sections.heading: Repository architecture
sections.excerpt:
SCPN-QC-CONTRACTS owns versioned boundary records and their compatibility semantics. It must have no dependency on numerical solvers, provider SDKs, research-specific constants, benchmark harnesses or Studio presentation code. Consumers depend on contracts; contracts never import consumers.

The first domain change must bind every introduced record/schema to its actual upstream source, namespace, field population, units, shapes, limits and error states. Existing evidence-manifest contracts retain their ownership and semantics. A convenient local rewrite cannot become a competing authority.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
 A[Owned upstream specifications] --> C[Versioned public contracts]
 C --> N[Numerical libraries]
 C --> H[Hardware abstraction]
 C --> T[Independent evidence tools]
 C --> S[Studio public consumers]
```

Data flow is producer input → admitted versioned record → consumer output. An admissible record preserves the complete supplied information and locating refusal; absent values do not become zero and unknown versions do not acquire defaults. Executable authority stays with the caller's installed programme and is never selected by a string inside a received record.

Current domain inventory is empty. Implementation will enrol source, schema, fixture and consumer roots in the native gates in its same complete change. Read [the boundary decision](docs/adr/0001-repository-boundary.md) and [threat model](docs/THREAT_MODEL.md) before adding a surface.

sections.heading: Contract ownership and compatibility
sections.excerpt:
The repository owns the versioned parameter/result and semantic boundary records shared by numerical libraries, hardware abstraction and evidence consumers. It has no domain implementation yet.

Before introducing a record, resolve the authoritative upstream schema and consumer contract. Specify every member, unit, shape, precision, allowed domain, absent/refused state, version transition and source-reference rule. Producer and consumer exercise the same complete contract. Never select executable authority from received bytes.

The top-level architecture describes dependency direction. Domain implementation enrols each source and generated interface in its owning native checks; generated output is reproduced from its qualified generator rather than patched independently. Legacy compatibility and no-loss migration require actual installed consumers and failure/rollback evidence.

sections.heading: Repository tooling boundary
sections.excerpt:
The scaffold is under construction. Its tooling separates source inventory,
native configuration validation, check orchestration and bounded process execution.
The inventory reconciles actual maintained files with the declared roots. The
configuration validator binds those roots to strict types, native lint and the
complete statement/branch coverage denominator. The preflight CLI executes the
selected native commands in order and records their actual outcomes; a failed
stage cannot be overwritten by a later successful command. Each report stays
inside a fresh private directory in the selected checkout.

The test check runs the real module-owned suite under coverage, combines actual
subprocess measurements, enforces 100% statement and branch coverage, then emits
its measured report. A selected check proves its stated scope only. Complete
scaffold qualification still requires every applicable repository gate and review.

The source projection uses Git's complete tracked and non-ignored untracked
file population, including an unborn local branch. It rejects private paths,
symlinks, oversized source files and observed source changes. It copies the
complete public byte cohort into a fresh private output directory, preserving
ordinary executable permissions, and records its file digests separately.
Licence validation runs on that complete projection. Internal planning and
rebuildable artefacts are neither copied nor licensed to make the check pass.
The caller owns the source cohort during projection; this exporter does not
promise an atomic snapshot against arbitrary concurrent filesystem writers.

The analysis-report gate checks actual SARIF files produced by the selected
scanner step. It refuses missing reports, malformed runs, reported findings
and failed or warning/error

readme_excerpts: SPIKE-LOG is the planned record and replay container for event streams. The selected design stores ordered canonical events and source-native side streams in chunked `.slog` files, with an index, integrity chain, capture provenance and a detached evidence seal.

The repository is under local scaffold construction. Evidence maturity is `architecture_only`; implemented domain capabilities, public claims and qualified schema inventories are empty. No container writer, capture adapter, replay engine or physical measurement is qualified here.

The product owns recording, replay, metadata inspection, complete container verification and provenance-preserving slicing. External format conversion belongs to SPIKE-FORMAT-BRIDGE. Event quality judgement and ground-truth generation belong to their own tools. LOOP-TIMING-WITNESS owns capture instrumentation; SC-NeuroCore owns neural adapters and model outputs.

sections.heading: Record, replay and container boundaries
sections.excerpt:
```mermaid
flowchart LR
 P[Immutable pre-capture plan] --> C[Source-owned capture]
 C --> W[Bounded container writer]
 W --> S[Chunked slog bytes and index]
 S --> V[Independent whole-container reader]
 S --> R[Logical replay]
 S --> X[New slice with original provenance]
 V --> E[Detached evidence and reports]
```

The plan precedes capture; a completed result references the plan and container later. A container never hashes itself or a future result. Detached evidence signing is consumed from EVIDENCE-MANIFEST-TOOLKIT, with actual class and qualification limits.

The canonical event shape retains signed integer ticks, geometry, polarity and stream identity. Original order is preserved; explicit unsorted sources remain labelled rather than silently sorted. Chunk counts, tick bounds, index byte offsets and the whole integrity chain are checked against actual bytes. Partial recovery is a new partial identity with visible gaps, never complete verification.

DVS columns and source-native APS/IMU/trigger/external bytes remain distinct. An external codec needs an actual selected parser before interpreted semantics can be accepted. In particular, neural state/spike/service bytes are not DVS pixels. Empty complete streams and missing streams are different states.

Planned production surfaces are record, replay, inspect, verify and slice. They are implemented together with their actual producer/consumer boundaries, strict checks, dedicated tests and corresponding documentation. The current source tree contains repository validation infrastructure under construction; planned runtime names do not imply available commands.

sections.heading: Container data flow
sections.excerpt:
The immutable capture plan precedes container bytes; final run results are later objects. Header, chunks, exact index offsets and footer are checked as a whole, with the seal detached. A corruption report locates the damaged region and refuses complete verification.

Source-native side bytes retain their codec identity and complete source population. Unknown codecs can be archived without claiming interpreted semantics. Replay requests preserve logical event content; achieved timing is separately observed. Slicing creates a new content identity with retained source provenance.

The repository does not convert third-party formats, judge event quality, synthesize ground truth or implement capture hardware. Those boundaries remain with the owning tools.

readme_excerpts:
Independent researcher and systems engineer at the
[Anulum Institute](https://anulum.li) in Switzerland. The programme runs on
**one engine**: an autonomous coding and verification system that builds,
tests and reviews the projects on this page and binds their claims to
evidence. The engine is put to work in **four domains**: reactor systems,
systems integration and control, neuromorphic computing, and quantum
computing. Claims are only as good as the measurements, artefacts, or
verification that support them.

Each card links to inspectable artefacts, not summary claims. Evidence links
are pinned to the commit they were verified at. Release and CI badges report
registry and workflow state; they are operational signals, not scientific-quality
scores.

Timeline entries distinguish registry facts from self-published chronology. They
do not imply academic affiliation, external validation, funding, or awards.
